verdict.rationale: Spline documents a Self-Hosted export that packages an entire project, its assets and the Spline runtime into a self-contained ZIP, plus code exports to Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js and react-three-fiber. These are per-scene web deliverables that still depend on Spline's runtime. Files otherwise live in Spline's cloud, and the pricing page lists these exports among plan features. Missing for 10: export to open 3D interchange formats (e.g. glTF/OBJ/USD), bulk account-wide data export, an exit path independent of the Spline runtime, clarity on which plans include export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
